about_the_game:
STORY

The seal is broken, revealing the hidden castle of the Succubus Queen in the desert.

Adventurers from all over rush toward the desert castle, seeking the Succubus Queen's buried treasure.

As various adventurers head for the treasure, the player takes on the role of a futanari imp—a lust demon—fighting humans to protect the treasure of her master, the Succubus Queen Mardic.

GAMEPLAY

Control the imp and defeat enemies aiming for the Succubus Queen's treasure!
Use direct attacks, magic, and even masturbation-based semen attacks!
Defeat enemies to punish them! But beware—enemies will also target the imp's body!?

FEATURES

  • 2D side-scrolling action game combining magic and combat elements.

  • Hand-drawn 2D animation for smooth character motion, vividly depicting both battles and H-scenes.

  • After losing to enemies, specific events and animations can be viewed in a memory/replay mode.

  • Multiple difficulty levels are available, including an Easy mode suitable for beginners.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains sexual content such as sexual acts, extreme violence, sexual violence, and non-consensual sex. This game also contains BDSM and Bestiality that you might be sensitive to. Please consider playing or not.
